summary: A NestJS JSON API on Node with feature modules, dependency injection, class-validator DTOs and Swagger docs.
description: Start a JSON API on NestJS, the framework that organizes a Node backend into modules, controllers and injectable services. Request bodies and queries are DTO classes checked by a global validation pipe, one exception filter turns every error into the same envelope with a request id, and Nest's JSON logger records one line per request. Swagger serves the OpenAPI document and docs page. An in-memory notes module shows list, get and create, with Vitest unit specs and Supertest contract tests on the real app module. Storage, accounts and deployment are left for you to add.
seoDescription: A NestJS JSON API on Node with modules and DI, class-validator DTOs, Swagger OpenAPI docs and Vitest plus Supertest tests.

projectExamples.title: Backend for a growing product team
projectExamples.description: An illustrative API that several developers extend one feature module at a time, each with its controller, service and tests. Add a database and sign-in before it holds real users' data.

plain.whatItIs: A starter server written in TypeScript on NestJS, a structured framework that splits a backend into modules, and answers apps with JSON data.
